scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp manifest.json src/popup.html src/dashboard.html src/style.css dist/ && cp -R assets _locales dist/
scripts.dev: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --firefox /usr/bin/firefox --start-url 'about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox'
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
